claims.text: Current large language models are insufficient for accurate probability estimations.
Large language models can generate relevant factors that may affect probabilities.
Large language models can produce coarse-grained probabilities when information is more complete.
Large language models can help determine which factors are relevant to specific downstream contexts.
BIRD provides reliable probability estimations that are 30% better than those provided directly by LLM baselines.
BIRD's probability estimates contribute to better and more trustworthy decision making.

evidence.description: Experimental evaluation demonstrating BIRD provides probability estimations that improve upon direct LLM baseline estimations by 30%.

methodologies.name: BIRD
methodologies.description: A probabilistic inference framework that aligns a Bayesian network with LLM abductions and estimates accurate probabilities via a deduction step.

limitations.text: Current large language models (LLMs) are insufficient for accurate probability estimations.
